exam_scheme.note: The Chennai Mathematical Institute (CMI) conducts its nationwide entrance examination for admission into undergraduate programmes (B.Sc. Honours in Mathematics & Computer Science and B.Sc. Honours in Mathematics & Physics), as well as postgraduate (M.Sc.) and doctoral (Ph.D.) programmes in Mathematics, Computer Science, and Data Science. The undergraduate entrance examination is an offline pen-and-paper test of 180 minutes (3 hours) duration carrying 100 marks. The paper consists of two distinct components: Part A (objective multiple-choice and short-answer questions, ~10 questions, 40 marks), which serves as a qualifying preliminary screening filter; and Part B (extended subjective mathematical questions requiring rigorous proofs and step-by-step reasoning, ~6 questions, 60 marks). Part B answer scripts are evaluated only for candidates who cross the qualifying cutoff in Part A. Marking scheme for Part A incorporates negative marks for incorrect multiple-choice attempts.
